result: The authors demonstrate through time-resolved crystallography that I-PpoI catalysis requires one and only one divalent metal ion. Over 40 atomic resolution structures were determined during the reaction process, showing DNA hydrolysis occurring in crystallo with product formation correlating strongly (R² = 0.97-0.98) with metal ion binding. Even at high Mn²⁺ concentrations (200 mM), no additional metal ions were detected by anomalous diffraction.

The strong quantitative correlations (R² > 0.97) between metal ion binding and product formation across all conditions, combined with the absence of additional anomalous signals at 200 mM Mn²⁺, provide robust support for the single metal ion mechanism.
